sections.changelog:
Added

  • **"Check for updates" button next to the ready-made dictionaries.** The pack list is cached for half a day, so a freshly published dictionary or version stayed invisible until that expired — with nothing on the screen to ask for it sooner. The button clears that cache and reloads the list on the spot. It also works when the list failed to load at all, which is exactly when someone wants to retry.
